resources.string: Browse cached comments
Cached comments

Local reload reads this account’s saved TikTok/Toki snapshots without downloading. Online first/next-page buttons explicitly request one native comment-list page and save copied rows to Toki’s private archive. Text, author names and cached replies are available; images and profiles are not fetched. Cached translations can be switched per comment. Enable the separate online-translation option to explicitly translate a selected comment when connected; complete results are saved for offline reuse. No automatic network pagination is started by scrolling; separate reply-thread requests and native comment-button replacement are not connected.

Online translation for cached comments

Off by default. Prepares TikTok’s translation channel independently; then the cached-comment viewer can submit one explicitly selected comment, display original/translation/bilingual and save complete results privately for later offline viewing. The host channel chooses its target language. No batch/background comment submission or local model is added; local-data-only prevents online requests. Initial preparation may take time.
